lines.ruling: Ruling: model error; i1040gi p. 98, Schedule 1, line 21: the deduction is allowed only if "You, or your spouse if filing jointly, aren't claimed as a dependent on someone else's (such as your parent's) 2025 tax return." The reply drops that condition (its note says no input answers 'claimed'); the request's person collection carries person.sav_claimed, which the project counts in sli.claimed_count. Same point as the earlier rulings on this line. The review was occasioned by the reworded sli.assisted_any (employer educational assistance, p970 p. 33) and sli.unqualified_any (a loan the filer was not legally obligated to pay, p970 p. 33); the reply's exclusions match the project's on both. Project stands.

Ruling: representation; i1040gi p. 99, Student Loan Interest Deduction Worksheet, line 1, and p970 p. 33, Don't Include as Interest and No Double Benefit Allowed. Both take the interest less the unqualified amount (now including a loan the filer was not legally obligated to pay) and less the assisted amount (now including interest an employer paid under an educational assistance program), floored at zero and capped at $2,500; subtracting the two in turn with a zero floor equals subtracting their sum. The project asks the exclusions only after sli.any on a return not married filing separately (sli.any_if_not_mfs); the reply reads them directly, and the deduction is zero on a separate return under both. Same point as the earlier rulings on this line. Project stands.

Ruling: representation; project retained. The worksheet gives no amount for married filing separately, which cannot take the deduction; the project enters zero there and the second enters $85,000. Neither reaches Schedule 1 line 21: sli.deduction is zero for married filing separately.
Ruling: equivalent; project retained. Line 6 is used only when line 4 is more than line 5 (line 8 skips it otherwise), where the signed difference and the floored one are the same.

Ruling: equivalent; project retained. The project skips to zero when line 4 is not more than line 5, as the worksheet says; the second always applies the ratio, which then has a part of zero or less, and prorate keeps the ratio at 0 or more, so it also gives zero (the same argument as the classified mutant on sli.line8).
Ruling: equivalent; project retained. Line 8 never exceeds line 1: prorate's ratio is at most 1.000 (Lean lemma prorate_le_amount), so the floor at zero never applies.
